Why Me

Most GoHighLevel builds fail for a boring reason.

Nobody double-checks the details. I've spent 10 years catching fraud and scams, so I build your GHL account like someone's going to audit it. Because eventually, someone always does.

Here are a few, among other things, (let's just go with) other stuff I have experience on that will surely make your campaign or project solved efficiently, effectively — and successfully:

  • 5+ years building and running GoHighLevel CRMs — pipelines, automations, workflows, and campaigns, end to end.
  • Designed and launched full GoHighLevel websites and funnels from scratch — not just templates.
  • Built multi-channel automations (SMS, email, voicemail drops) that keep leads moving without manual follow-up.
  • Comfortable going into existing, messy GHL accounts to audit, fix, and optimize — not just building from a blank canvas.
  • Connect GHL with outside tools and APIs so your whole stack talks to each other, not just the CRM.
  • 5 years as a Fraud Analyst (including Tier 3 supervisory escalations) in a financial account, catching credit-card fraud schemes and handling escalations — the same fraud-analyst-grade attention to detail now goes into every workflow I build.
  • I use AI tools like Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT to work faster and deliver more.
